furion_sprout.desc: Grows a ring of trees around a unit or a point for a few seconds, trapping whoever is inside, damaging nearby enemies and revealing the area.

furion_teleportation.desc: After a long cast, teleports anywhere on the map and arrives with a barrier that absorbs damage. The destination is visible to everyone while casting; an interrupted cast costs nothing.

furion_force_of_nature.desc: Turns the trees in the target area into Treants, one per tree up to a cap. Treants are temporary and deal extra damage to heroes.

furion_curse_of_the_forest.desc: Curses nearby enemy heroes: they are shown through the fog, and every tree or Treant close to them slows them and burns them each second.

furion_spirit_of_the_forest.desc: Gains bonus attack damage for every nearby tree and even more for every living Treant. Treants get the same bonus from trees and Treants around them.

furion_wrath_of_nature.desc: Unleashes energy that jumps across the map between visible enemies, starting near the target. Every enemy struck makes the following strikes stronger.
